gating: Run layers in order. Do not run a layer until every case in the layer before it passes.

unit.case: new <slug> rejects extra positional arguments with a usage failure before creating a directory or branch
new ignores a malformed legacy .ai-eng-worktrees.json, creates no manifest, and leaves any existing manifest bytes untouched
rm neither reads, rewrites nor removes a legacy manifest, including a malformed one
manifest removal preserves configured-root resolution, slug validation, Git inventory, branch creation from local main, merged-branch protection and safe removal
list uses only Git-listed feature worktrees and reads each lifecycle checkpoint from that worktree's own path, not from the primary checkout or a copied plan
clean, dirty, detached and otherwise unclassified Git worktrees are reported with the correct status and evidence without changing refs, files or index state
missing, unreadable or malformed lifecycle state remains visible as unknown and cannot authorize approval, merge or removal
a legacy checkpoint with no lifecycle keeps existing checkpoint-gate behavior, is reported as unknown, and grants no lifecycle approval or merge/removal authority
likely-overlap evidence includes relevant Git status and checkpoint paths, while listing remains read-only
valid lifecycle initialization and every documented phase/approval transition are accepted with their required gates and reviewed_main
malformed or contradictory lifecycle data, skipped or unauthorized transitions, and missing, invalid or stale reviewed_main are rejected; advancing local main requires review reset and repetition
brainstorm and orchestrator call the same read-only local worktree preflight before new or resumed work
Phase 0 resumes the same slug at its Git-listed path, or creates a clean feature worktree before Phase 1 begins
likely-overlap preflight pauses for a human decision while clearly unrelated work can continue
dirty, missing or uncertain work is preserved and reported; preflight does not reset, remove or sync it
preflight stays local, does not fetch or merge an unapproved sibling, and neither creates a plan in the primary checkout nor copies one between worktrees
Phase 0 stops before new, resume, rebase, rm or reset when the same slug is dirty or unknown, preserving its state
preflight surfaces awaiting-plan-approval, awaiting-app-review and ready-to-merge with the required human decision before orchestrator continues
a new checkpoint plan is created only in the selected feature worktree with awaiting-plan-approval, pending plan approval, app review not-started and reviewed_main null
lifecycle initialization rejects a distinct symlink alias to the canonical checkpoint path while canonical feature-worktree initialization succeeds
implementation does not start or dispatch until the human approves the plan; approval then permits the transition to implementation
pending approval and skipped phases cannot enter implementation; the explicitly approved state can transition after the human plan-review handoff, while legacy gate behavior is preserved
a clean feature worktree rebases successfully onto the current local refs/heads/main only, with exact fixture refs and resulting history asserted

rebase <slug> targets only its matching Git-registered feature worktree, runs git rebase refs/heads/main without accepting another base, leaves lifecycle bytes unchanged and reports the exact full local-main SHA

dirty status, missing worktree or checkpoint, malformed, legacy or unknown checkpoint, and mismatched or detached worktree each refuse before mutation; refs, status, present checkpoint bytes and worktree registration remain unchanged
an unresolved rebase conflict returns failure while leaving Git's rebase in progress for agent resolution or abort, without modifying lifecycle state

a controlled temporary Git hook advances local refs/heads/main after rebase selects the previous tip; the command reports exact before/after main SHAs and rerun-sync guidance, claims sync and writes lifecycle state or reviewed_main only if the post-rebase main tip is an ancestor of feature HEAD, and otherwise preserves rewritten feature state without reset or rollback

a clear rebase conflict is resolved only inside the feature worktree; affected behavior gates rerun first, UI gates only when the checkpoint has UI, then affected review gates, all before human app review

an unclear conflict or failed check aborts the rebase and verifies original refs, tree and status before marking lifecycle blocked; dirty, missing/unknown, malformed or untrusted lifecycle preconditions stop without mutation, preserving checkpoint bytes and Git state
only after synchronization and affected gates pass does lifecycle record the exact current local-main reviewed_main and set app review pending

two merge transactions based on the same reviewed_main race through real temporary Git worktrees; compare-and-swap publishes at most one merge, the loser publishes no stale second merge, and an unmerged feature worktree remains for fresh review without a custom lock

in a real temporary Git repository, a post-commit hook advances refs/heads/main after the temporary merge commit is created; compare-and-swap against reviewed_main fails with exact old/new refs, cleans only the temporary worktree and publishes no stale merge, while preserving the feature worktree and data; changed main requires resynchronization, affected gates and renewed review

only the approved feature is merged normally in a temporary detached worktree so commit hooks run; assert exact merge parents reviewed_main and reviewed_feature before compare-and-swap publication, then verify feature ancestry before removal while an unapproved sibling is neither merged nor deleted

after successful compare-and-swap, safely refresh the primary checkout with git reset --merge, clean the temporary merge worktree, and verify the published merge and reviewed_feature ancestry before safe feature-worktree removal; failed or uncertain refresh, state or ancestry verification preserves the feature worktree

ready-to-merge requires completed gates, approved app review, and fresh reviewed_main plus reviewed_feature; the removed complete lifecycle phase is rejected while legacy checkpoint-gate behavior remains unchanged

if temporary-worktree merge or commit hooks fail, abort only the temporary merge and remove only a clean temporary worktree; no main ref is published and the feature worktree, lifecycle state and data remain unchanged

if primary refresh or safe feature-worktree removal is interrupted after compare-and-swap, retry is idempotent: recognize the already-published merge with exact reviewed parents, safely refresh and verify ancestry, then remove only the approved feature worktree

the feature lifecycle never becomes complete before removal; while its worktree is still Git-listed its checkpoint retains an active phase, and removal/absence from Git inventory represents closed work
the orchestrator-close contract assertion follows the reviewed_feature and atomic worktree merge handoff instead of retired manual merge/removal instructions

cli.case: regenerate src/assets.ts after the first checkpoint's skill changes
the regenerated skill payload matches the source canon after checkpoint 3
regenerate src/assets.ts after the plan-approval skill changes
the regenerated skill payload matches the source canon after checkpoint 4
regenerate src/assets.ts after the rebase-skill changes
the regenerated skill payload matches the source canon after checkpoint 5

the exact `ai-eng worktree rebase <slug>` CLI invocation uses only the registered matching feature worktree and local refs/heads/main, emits the full main SHA on success, refuses arbitrary base arguments and leaves an unresolved conflict available for agent handling
regenerate src/assets.ts after the final lifecycle skill changes
the regenerated skill payload matches the source canon after checkpoint 6
the architecture boundary remains valid after worktree and lifecycle changes
the complete repository test suite passes after the focused feature checks

the exact `ai-eng worktree merge <slug>` CLI command validates fresh reviewed refs, publishes only a verified reviewed_main/reviewed_feature merge with compare-and-swap, safely refreshes and removes the approved feature, and preserves it on races

not_tested: API layer: no HTTP endpoint, server, database, persistence service or API authorization surface exists for this local CLI and skill workflow.

UI layer: the feature has no application screen, browser interaction or responsive layout; all worktree visibility and approval-flow behavior is exercised at the CLI, state-validation and workflow-contract layers.
Cross-clone or remote coordination is deliberately not tested because the approved design is local-only and forbids remote synchronization in this lifecycle.
Live human approval is represented by explicit state-transition and handoff tests; tests do not invoke an actual person or run a multi-agent production session.
